name: Ca chach kho
summary: Cá chạch kho is named twice by Báo Nam Định. On 30 January 2023 it is cá chạch kho niêu in the coastal list for Hải Hậu, Nghĩa Hưng, and Giao Thủy. On 25 November 2022 it is an OCOP product, cá chạch kho Nghĩa Hưng. A method beyond the name was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Nghĩa Hưng on the OCOP line. The coastal list also names Hải Hậu and Giao Thủy. Both stay.
howToEat: A serving method was not printed. Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Nghĩa Hưng, and the coastal districts named with it. A door was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ca chach kho — a Nghia Hung name
seoDescription: Loach braised in a clay pot, named for Nghĩa Hưng and the coast. A method and a price were not printed. Check on arrival.
